source: Wikimedia Commons IPA-chart recordings (see data/ipa/ATTRIBUTION.md); analysis by tools/build_sounds.py

analysis.strip: per energetic frame (≤ 40 dB below max), full-band realizable R, ≤ 60 frames
analysis.trajectory: diphthongs: 30 LAR-interpolation steps start->end, full-band realizable R
analysis.audio_synth: core.synth.speak(a, class, voiced, f0=120) = the film's own voice with class excitation (noise / mixed / closure-burst-aspiration / burst+frication / glottal); diphthongs: core.synth.sing(domain='lar')

rules.vowel: voiced frames (periodicity > 0.45, ZCR < 0.25) within 20 dB of the loudest frame.
rules.nasal: voiced frames within 30 dB of the loudest frame; if the file also contains a context vowel (spread of the <500 Hz energy fraction over voiced frames > 0.15) keep only frames whose low-frequency fraction is in the upper half of that range (nasal murmur has F1 < 400 Hz, the vowel [a] does not).
rules.lateral: as nasal (voiced, low-F1 frames: [l] has F1 ≈ 300-400 Hz, lower than the context vowel).
rules.approximant: as nasal (voiced, low-F1 frames: [ɹ w j] have F1 ≈ 250-400 Hz, lower than the context vowel).
rules.fricative: voiceless: aperiodic (periodicity < 0.4) frames within 40 dB of the loudest frame whose >2.5 kHz energy fraction or ZCR marks frication (hf > 0.3 or ZCR > 0.2); [h] has no high-frequency requirement (aperiodic frames only). Voiced: frames within 40 dB whose >2.5 kHz energy fraction is at least 60 % of the file's maximum (frication rides on voicing).
rules.plosive: release bursts: hop positions where the level jumps by ≥ 15 dB within 2 hops from a quiet frame (≤ −30 dB re max); the onset is refined to 1 ms and ONE 512-sample frame starting 8 ms before the onset is analysed per burst (burst + aspiration/transition; for voiced plosives the following vowel onset contributes).
rules.affricate: closure -> burst -> frication: release bursts are found as for plosives (≥ 15 dB jump within 2 hops from a frame ≤ −30 dB re max); per burst the 512-sample frame starting 8 ms before the onset is analysed PLUS the following hop frames while they stay fricated (within 40 dB of the loudest frame and hf > 0.3 or ZCR > 0.2; voiceless additionally aperiodic, periodicity < 0.4; voiced: hf ≥ 50 % of the max hf after the burst), at most 25 frames (400 ms) per burst. If no burst is found, the fricative rule of the same voicing is used (noted).
rules.diphthong: not a recording: time-varying film. The start and end vowel polynomials (items of this file) are interpolated linearly in the log-area-ratio domain LAR = 2·atanh(k), t = 0..1 (30 steps) -> k(t) -> a(t) -> film -> colour (trajectory). a/k/colours of the item are the midpoint t = 0.5. Audio: core.synth.sing([a_start, a_end], [d/2, d/2], domain='lar') = hold, glide, hold.
rules.fallback: if a rule selects no frame, all frames within 40 dB of the loudest are used (noted in the item).
